During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[T'Charek Haathi]] led a [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Operations]] '''team''' that specialized in ship jacking. The team initially consisted of Haathi, [[Ivhin Jayme]], [[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]], and [[Dren Nord]]. Nord left and was replaced by [[Maglenna Pendower]].<ref name="AJ14">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
